rules: RODAS five? no: original eight stages remain strict-lower causal.
Affine composition is exact-arithmetic associative but noncommutative; floating reassociation changes rounding.
Current scan is serial O(m log m) work and serial time; O(log m) is not attained.
Blelloch O(m) work/O(log m) span is a candidate, not measured speed.
JVP is derivative action; matrix-free is no explicit matrix, not no solve.
Peer-W is a separate two-step method with history/startup/estimator/restart.
Stored output bytes are not peak RSS.
Current fair-ab exists; replay current source; don't recreate it.
Legacy v0.10 is not an ancestor of current C5 source.
